svg.title: Lily Logger
svg.desc: FrogPilot (driver-assistance software for cars) profile badge, Lily Logger, shown on FrogPilot.com while a member's device sends drive logs to FrogPilot: the FrogPilot frog as a long-haul truck driver in a red trucker cap with white mesh and a lily pad patch and a blue plaid flannel shirt, holding open a driver's logbook.
